subject.title: fix(ui): unify split-view controls in one toolbar row

question: Should Control UI accept this PR's split-mode toolbar direction, replacing breadcrumb content with split-pane controls while split view is active?
rationale: The patch appears technically coherent and well-proven, but it changes a visible global shell ownership rule on a protected maintainer-labeled PR.

options.title: Accept toolbar unification
options.body: Merge the PR after normal exact-head CI because the implementation matches the linked issue and removes duplicated split-view chrome.

options.title: Narrow to split-entry relocation
options.body: Ask the author to keep pane headers for now and only move the classic split action out of the composer.

options.title: Keep current split chrome
options.body: Close or pause the PR if maintainers prefer breadcrumbs and per-pane headers to remain separate.
